channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Indian River County families can apply for free or reduced-price student meals starting July 15
item.description: Families in Indian River County are able to apply for free or reduced price meals for students starting July 15.

item.title: Waterspout crosses Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian as severe weather batters Treasure Coast
item.description: A large waterspout passed over the Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian on Friday afternoon as severe weather brought heavy rain, lightning strikes and fires across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK flights in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season with four-game road trip
item.description: The Florida Panthers will begin their 2026-27 NHL regular season on the road against the Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes on Sept. 29.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence in game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball has made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record at London Diamond League
item.description: Josh Kerr of Great Britain ran the mile in 3:42.66 on Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's previous world record of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: World Cup final tickets in New Jersey start at $7,700 for Argentina-Spain match
item.description: The cheapest ticket on resale sites for Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain in New Jersey costs about $7,700, nearly identical to what the median U.S. household earns in one month.

item.title: World Cup boosts U.S. beer sales 14% in host cities during tournament
item.description: Beer sales in bars, restaurants, stadiums and other venues rose 14% in U.S. host cities during the first four weeks of the World Cup compared to the same period last year, according to the Beer Institute.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis Jr. join Miami Heat in major trade
item.description: The Miami Heat introduced two-time NBA MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and forward Bobby Portis Jr. at the Kaseya Center on Thursday, with both players receiving standing ovations from fans.
